title: Linear filament and nested cluster evolution tomography (LANCET): I. Capture the evolution of dense gas in 14-parsec filament G316.8
question: How does dense gas structure evolve and assemble mass across a single 14-parsec filament (G316.8) spanning young, intermediate, and evolved stages of massive star and cluster formation?

data.angular_resolution: 7.4'' x 5.3'' (PA -85.4 deg), ~6'' (0.08 pc); 6.2'' for combined high-resolution column density map
data.sensitivity: ~2 mJy beam^-1 (0.3 M_sun mass sensitivity at 20 K); 4 mJy beam^-1 before self-calibration

evidence.quote: On the near side of the Scutum-Centaurus Arm, the G316.8 filament lies at a heliocentric distance of $2.8\pm0.5$ kpc (cite: Reid2019).

recipe.goal: Construct multi-resolution dust temperature and column density maps
recipe.method: Fit single-component modified blackbody SEDs pixel-by-pixel at 36.3'' (Herschel 160-500 um) and 18'' (Herschel 160, 250 um + APEX/ArTéMiS 350, 450 um), extrapolate the 18'' SED to 1.3 mm, combine with ACA 7m 1.3 mm continuum in the uv domain using J-comb, convert combined 1.3 mm image to 6.2'' column density using 18'' dust temperature, and merge 6'', 18'', and 36'' maps in the image domain via weighted edge fusion.
key_parameters: 36.3'' coarse resolution with 14.0'' pixel size; 18'' medium resolution; 6.2'' high resolution
assumptions: Single-component graybody emission; Hildebrand (1983) dust opacity kappa_0 = 0.1 cm^2 g^-1 at 300 um (gas+dust), spectral index beta = 2.0, mean molecular weight mu = 2.8
Dust temperature changes slowly and 1.3 mm emission is purely thermal dust emission

recipe.goal: Measure global subregion properties and extract hierarchical dense fragments
recipe.method: Define subregion ROI where N_H2 > 3e22 cm^-2 on 18'' map to sum cloud mass and FIR luminosity; run astrodendro on the ACA 7m 1.3 mm continuum map to identify hierarchical structures (leaves/fragments) and compute deconvolved sizes and isothermal masses.
key_parameters: astrodendro min_value = 3 sigma, min_delta = 1 sigma, min_npix = pixels in half a synthesized beam
assumptions: Distance d = 2.8 kpc, deconvolution factor eta = 2.4, leaf dust temperature taken from mean of 18'' temperature map within leaf mask

recipe.goal: Compute and fit Column Density Probability Distribution Functions (N-PDFs)
recipe.method: Subtract uniform foreground/background column density measured in a 5'x5' box, bin normalized logarithmic column density eta = ln(N_H2 / <N_H2>) with 0.1 dex bins for quiet and active regions, and fit a piecewise lognormal + 1 or 2 power-law tail (PLT) model using MCMC.
key_parameters: Background N_H2 = 7e21 cm^-2 in 5' x 5' box; bin size = 0.1 dex; intrinsic scatter s_int = 0

recipe.goal: Perform Delta-variance structural analysis across subregions
recipe.method: Convolve the multi-resolution H2 column density map with a circularly symmetric wavelet over 50 spatial lags from 0.04 to 2.04 pc, estimate uncertainties via 500 block-bootstrap realizations, and fit a double power-law model over lags 0.1 to 0.9 pc.
key_parameters: Annulus-to-core-diameter ratio = 1.5; 50 lags from 0.04 to 2.04 pc; 500 bootstrap realizations; DPL fit range [0.1, 0.9] pc with fixed break at 0.3 pc
